# clio sync serve

run the sync server in the foreground

## Usage

```
clio sync serve [--bind ADDR] [--banks a,b] [--token-file PATH] [--ttl-secs N] [--dev] [--output json|text]
```

## Description

runs in the foreground for the resolved TTL (default 1800s); --token-file loads the shared credential store (each secret reaches only its record's banks) on every request, so revocation takes effect at the next request; a configured credential source (--token-file) requires a secret on every request, dev mode included

a bind to a non-loopback address is refused unless the operator setting `sync.allow_public_bind` allows it, and it also needs a credential store (`--token-file`) in every mode including --dev, so a token-less bind is refused even when the setting allows it; an admitted bind with a credential store warns on stderr, in every mode including --dev: bank scope (which bank a row belongs to), record kind (which shape the peer opens), operation (what the peer applies), transaction time (the order rows win in), and device id (which node wrote a row, and the tie-break when timestamps are equal) cross the network in the clear; the record identifier and the content digest cross in the clear too, in a form derived under a key the relay does not hold, so a relay can neither read them nor confirm a guessed value against them, though it does hold one stable value per row, and an identifier the machine generated is sent unchanged rather than as such a form; a relay also sees the record-kind mix and the device-id stability across time, which are routing-necessary rather than harmless; only the content and the admission score are sealed; this describes rows pushed from a sealing-capable build onward, and rows already on a relay keep their older cleartext identifiers until they are naturally re-pushed; put a TLS-terminating reverse proxy in front of a public bind

## Options

| Option | Kind | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--bind ADDR` | text | `127.0.0.1:0` | Sets the address `sync serve` binds, as `host:port`; port 0 picks an ephemeral port. |
| `--banks a,b` | text |  | Limits the served banks; `sync_cli::banks_arg` splits the comma list and refuses one that names no bank. |
| `--token-file PATH` | text |  | Points at the shared credential store `sync serve` reads on every request; each secret reaches only its record's banks. |
| `--ttl-secs N` | uint | `1800` | Sets the foreground auto-stop TTL in seconds that `sync serve` applies; `sync_cli::serve_args` requires a whole number. |
| `--dev` |  |  | Allows a token-less anonymous bind on a loopback address only; a non-loopback bind needs a credential store (`--token-file`) in every mode, dev included. |
| `--output json\|text` | enum: json, text |  | Selects the output mode that `cli_output::resolve_output` returns; the terminal decides it when absent. |

## Global options

| Option | Kind | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--db PATH` | text |  | Overrides the store address that `db_target::resolve_target` opens; config and environment decide it when absent. |
| `--backend sqlite\|postgres` | enum: sqlite, postgres |  | Selects the store backend that `db_target::resolve_target` hands to the resolver; config or the address decides it when absent. |
| `--bank BANK` | text |  | Scopes the command to one bank; `cli_read_args::base_args` passes it to the tool and the write scope defaults to `default`. |
| `--actor ACTOR` | text |  | Names the acting identity; `cli_read_args::base_args` passes it to the tool and `auth_cli` reads it for the actor commands. |
| `--no-input` |  |  | Refuses interactive input; `backup_restore_cli` treats a run with it as non-interactive. |
| `--yes` |  |  | Answers yes to the destructive-confirmation gate that `cli_confirm::confirmed` applies. |

## Examples

Serve on an ephemeral loopback port with the shared credential store.
```
clio sync serve --token-file ./tokens.json
```

Serve on a fixed loopback port with the shared credential store.
```
clio sync serve --bind 127.0.0.1:8788 --token-file ./tokens.json
```

Allow a token-less bind for local development.
```
clio sync serve --bind 127.0.0.1:8788 --dev
```
